data.long_description:
Presenting this spacious 3-bedroom townhouse in Greenviews, Emaar South. The property features a well-laid-out floor plan with a seamless flow between living, dining, and kitchen spaces, creating a comfortable and practical home environment ideal for families.

Key Features:

⦁ 3 Bedrooms
⦁ 4 Bathrooms
⦁ Generous living and dining area
⦁ Modern kitchen layout
⦁ Well-sized bedrooms with built-in storage
⦁ Private garden/outdoor space
⦁ Multiple options available

The upper level hosts well-proportioned bedrooms designed for privacy and functionality, while the overall layout ensures maximum usability of space throughout the home. Large windows allow for ample natural light, enhancing the bright and airy feel of the interiors.

Located within the Greenviews community, residents enjoy a quiet, family-oriented setting with landscaped parks, walking trails, and convenient access to key areas across Dubai. The community continues to be a popular choice for tenants seeking value, space, and connectivity.

With multiple units available, this is a great opportunity to secure a quality 3-bedroom home in Emaar South.

For more information or to arrange a viewing, contact: Alwin Johny
